LanguageData.GR_GoauldDomainDoctrine_Conquest_Descrip: This domain favors overwhelming direct assaults. Abduction and destructive strikes remain possible when the colony presents a suitable opportunity, but military conquest is its dominant answer to resistance.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldDomainDoctrine_Enslavement_Desc: This domain prizes living captives and useful hosts. It favors abduction when the colony and available forces make capture plausible, while retaining direct assault as a dependable fallback.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldDomainDoctrine_ScorchedEarth_De: This domain prefers to break defiance by ruining infrastructure and supplies. Destructive strikes are favored when the colony is developed enough to present a worthwhile target, but direct assault remains available.
